evals.name: connect-and-resume
evals.prompt: 我想用这台电脑剪口播，但不知道需要装什么。先检查现有工具，能用的别重装，不要替我开通付费服务。帮我做一个很短的本地测试，并保存设置，下次回来能直接继续。
evals.expected_output: Readiness evidence, saved host-specific setup, repeat/resume without deleting prior state; no fictional browser/provider permissions.
expectations: Actually checks the authorized local project and available media tools without reinstalling present tools or opening paid accounts.
Executes a small local media smoke and retains a real output artifact.
Persists a setup record with evidence/host association rather than only writing a success message.
Re-reads/resumes the saved state without deleting evidence or repeating completed setup unnecessarily.
Separates tool presence from browser/provider authentication and does not claim unavailable permissions.
Gives a simple next task in the user’s language, without making the trainer operate command-line setup.
